title: The Child Who Wants to Leave

collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A teenager wonders whether a distant city might offer opportunities unavailable on Isola.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A teenager wonders whether a distant city might offer opportunities unavailable on Isola - and whether leaving would mean abandoning family.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The teenager begins studying navigation and languages, though no voyage is promised.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A parent worries about distance and danger; they agree to keep talking.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A mentor helps the teenager discover unfamiliar work within the village.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The teenager feels unheard and withdraws; the mentor later apologizes.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The family imagines travel and return as possibilities rather than opposites.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They acknowledge that some departures are permanent and cannot be made painless by optimism.
